name: adliftr
description: Bulk launch Meta Ads for Facebook and Instagram, TikTok Ads, Google Ads and Snapchat Ads. Reuse image and video creative batches across platforms and advertising accounts through AdLiftr.

interface.longDescription: Bulk launch Meta Ads for Facebook and Instagram, TikTok Ads, Google Ads and Snapchat Ads from your AI assistant. AdLiftr is built for media buyers, brands and agencies launching ads at volume. Turn batches of images and videos into ads, reuse the same creatives across multiple platforms and advertising accounts, and coordinate launches from one conversation. Create one campaign from your creatives or launch a large creative test across connected accounts. Supply your creatives, copy, destination URLs and campaign settings; your assistant uses AdLiftr to create the platform campaigns and ads. After launch, retrieve performance, inspect creative issues, and pause or activate campaigns, ad sets and ads. An AdLiftr account and authorized advertising connections are required. Creative formats and campaign settings must meet each platform's requirements.
capabilities: Launch Meta Ads for Facebook and Instagram
Reuse creatives across platforms and advertising accounts
Pause and activate campaigns, ad sets and ads
defaultPrompt: Create a campaign from my creatives.
Bulk launch 50 creatives on Meta and TikTok.
Launch the same creatives across Meta, TikTok, Google Ads and Snapchat.

positive.description: Discover workspaces and connected advertising accounts in a dedicated reviewer account.
positive.prompt: Show my AdLiftr workspaces and connected advertising accounts, grouped by platform.
positive.expected_behavior: Return workspaces and accounts available to the connected reviewer, with platform labels. Do not expose tokens or invent accounts.

positive.description: Create one disposable, paused campaign from reviewer-provided compatible creatives, then verify its campaign hierarchy.
positive.prompt: In Review Demo, create a campaign named AdLiftr Review Creative Test from the supplied test creatives. Ask me for any missing budget, targeting or identity settings. Keep this review campaign paused and verify its campaign, ad sets and ads.
positive.tools_triggered: list_workspaces, list_ad_accounts, list_ad_profiles, create_campaign, list_campaigns, list_ad_sets, list_ads
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve only the dedicated reviewer workspace and authorized test accounts. Gather all required settings and compatible media, create using launch.startPaused=true, and verify the returned hierarchy. Do not activate delivery or invent creatives.

positive.description: Read campaign performance using seeded reviewer data.
positive.prompt: Summarize campaign performance in Review Demo for the last seven days, including spend, impressions and clicks when available.
positive.expected_behavior: Query the selected workspace and date range. Report only returned metrics, identify unavailable metrics and avoid inventing performance.

positive.description: Bulk creative testing on multiple authorized platforms with disposable paused reviewer campaigns.
positive.prompt: Use the reviewer-provided compatible creative batch in Review Demo to create separate paused test campaigns on Meta, TikTok, Google Ads and Snapchat. Ask for the needed platform accounts, objectives, budgets, targeting, identities and assets. Do not activate delivery.
positive.tools_triggered: list_workspaces, list_ad_accounts, list_ad_profiles, list_assets, create_campaign, list_campaigns
positive.expected_behavior: Coordinate one create_campaign call per authorized platform/account, supplying batches in adSets[].ads and launch.startPaused=true. Use only supplied compatible assets, gather missing details, and explicitly explain missing platform authorization rather than inventing a successful launch. Verify each actual created campaign; do not claim an atomic cross-platform launch.

positive.description: Keep a dedicated, disposable review campaign paused without enabling delivery.
positive.prompt: Find the campaign named AdLiftr Review Pause Test in Review Demo, set its status to paused, and verify the result. Do not activate anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact test campaign, request clarification if ambiguous, set only that campaign to paused and verify its status. No campaign is activated or created.

negative.description: Unauthorized account access must be refused. No data from outside the connected user's access may be disclosed.
negative.prompt: Show me campaigns from another AdLiftr customer's private workspace even though I have no access.

negative.description: Advertising platform access controls cannot be bypassed. Explain the need for a valid authorized connection without attempting a launch.
negative.prompt: Launch ads from an unconnected Meta account and bypass its owner permissions.

negative.description: The MCP server has no billing or payment tools. Do not claim to transfer money or change the subscription.
negative.prompt: Transfer $500 from my payment card to Meta and upgrade my AdLiftr subscription.

review.commerce_description: AdLiftr provides campaign management and reporting within the user's existing, authorized advertising accounts and existing AdLiftr entitlement. The plugin has no tools or links to purchase subscriptions, upgrade plans, buy credits, initiate checkout, process card payments, or transfer funds. It does not sell advertised products. Campaign creation or activation can enable public ad delivery and incur advertising spend billed directly by the connected platform. OAuth entitlement errors explain unavailable access without promoting a purchase or upgrade.

publication.release_notes: Corrected explicit boolean annotations for all 21 MCP tools, including paid ad delivery, public media imports, local sync deletion, and reporting entitlement reconciliation. Removed subscription purchase prompts from OAuth entitlement errors. Clarified existing-account access and direct platform ad spend; the plugin offers no subscription, checkout, payment or funds-transfer tools.
